create_deepclusterv2_loss: create a DeepClusterV2Loss instance from an AttrDict configuration for self-supervised clustering
run_forward_loss: run the forward pass of DeepClusterV2Loss to compute cross-entropy loss against cluster assignments
init_memory_bank: initialize the memory bank with embeddings from a dataloader and model before training
cluster_memory_bank: cluster the memory bank using distributed k-means to update centroids and assignments
update_memory_bank: update the memory bank with new embeddings and indices after each forward pass
